title: EPA Section 608 Refrigerant Circuit & Pressure Boundary Escalation Rule
model: Home Split AC Cooling & Gas Leak Troubleshooter
operating_conditions: Suction pressure under 70 PSI, flare joint oil residue, active refrigerant bubbling, or burnt smell from compressor
summary: Mandatory regulatory boundary: Non-certified users must never pierce, gauge-tap, evacuate, or charge closed refrigerant circuits.
boundary_policy: Under Clean Air Act Section 608 and UL 60335-2-40, servicing flammable A2L refrigerants (R32) requires certified EPA Universal credentials and explosion-proof tooling.
mandated_qualification: EPA Universal / Level-2 Certified HVAC Field Technician
mandated_tools: Spark-Proof Recovery Machine & Dedicated R32 Recovery Cylinder
Dry Nitrogen Tank with 0-600 PSI Calibrated Regulator
sla_tier: Priority 1 - Field dispatch required within 4 hours if active odor or oil discharge is present

ordered_checks.action: Immediate Customer Directive: Switch AC off at mains breaker. Do not reset circuit breaker if it trips repeatedly.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: Prevents compressor motor burnout and explosive thermal breakdown.

ordered_checks.action: Halt procedure: Dispatch EPA Certified HVAC Technician. Technician must connect dry nitrogen at 450 PSI for 24-hr pressure decay test, replace defective flare copper, vacuum down to 500 microns, and charge factory weight R32 by digital electronic scale.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: MANDATORY TECHNICIAN ESCALATION: Hazardous pressurized refrigerant and flammable A2L gas hazard.

title: High-Voltage DC Bus & Capacitive Energy Storage Escalation Rule
operating_conditions: Inverter PCB failure, burnt silicon odor, motor winding short circuit, or DC bus capacitor testing
summary: Mandatory electrical safety boundary: DC link capacitors retain lethal voltage (380V to 4,000V DC) for up to 10 minutes following mains isolation.
boundary_policy: NFPA 70E and IEC 60335 safety standards mandate that live-chassis electrical measurements must only be performed by licensed appliance service technicians using insulated CAT-III equipment.
mandated_qualification: Certified Appliance Service Technician / Licensed Electrical Specialist
mandated_tools: High-Voltage Ceramic Bleeder Discharge Probe (20k Ohm / 50W)
sla_tier: Priority 2 - Scheduled on-site diagnostic service within 24 hours

ordered_checks.action: Immediate Customer Directive: Switch off appliance power at dedicated wall MCB. Disconnect power cord from wall outlet. Keep clear of rear cabinet access covers.

Halt procedure: Certified Electrical Technician must verify 0V DC across electrolytic capacitor terminals with CAT-III meter before inspecting inverter power module (IPM) or motor stator winding resistance.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: CRITICAL LETHAL VOLTAGE HAZARD: DC bus capacitors store up to 380V-4,000V DC energy.

title: Gas Supply Appliance Fuel Line Isolation & Flue Spillage Escalation Rule
subsystem: Natural Gas / Propane Gas Valve & Burner Assembly
operating_conditions: Gas odor (mercaptan rotten-egg smell), CO alarm sounding, soot accumulation on burner, or yellow burner flames
summary: Mandatory life safety policy: Any detected fuel gas leak or carbon monoxide anomaly requires immediate evacuation and emergency gas technician dispatch.
boundary_policy: National Fuel Gas Code (NFPA 54) prohibits non-certified individuals from disassembling, adjusting, or relighting compromised gas valve trains.
mandated_qualification: Licensed Gas Fitter / Certified Gas Appliance Field Specialist
mandated_tools: Digital Electronic Manometer for Gas Manifold Pressure (0-14 in. w.c.)
Ambient Carbon Monoxide (CO) Personal Safety Monitor
sla_tier: Emergency Priority 0 - Immediate fuel isolation and emergency gas utility notification

ordered_checks.action: Immediate Customer Directive: Turn off yellow manual gas shutoff valve immediately. Do not operate light switches, do not touch electrical appliances, and open windows to ventilate area.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: EXPLOSION & POISONING HAZARD: Do not create electrical sparks.

ordered_checks.action: Halt procedure: Licensed Gas Service Technician must perform 10 PSI differential pressure drop test across gas line, inspect thermocouple/flame rectification sensor, and certify zero combustible gas ppm before restoring supply.
ordered_checks.hazard_notice: CRITICAL EXPLOSION HAZARD: Live fuel gas testing requires certified gas fitter.
